title: Spider charts render blank: local const size shadows the size() formatter
description:
spider() in site/src/scripts/charts.js declared `const size`, shadowing the `size` formatter imported from ./util.js; its vertex tooltip then threw `TypeError: size is not a function` and every spider chart (home spider cards, model pages, characteristic pages with 3+ facets) rendered empty. The rename to `side` landed in 589809b (released 1.57.0) without a test. This bug adds a regression spec.

```gherkin
Feature: Chart helpers stay callable
  Scenario: No chart function shadows an imported helper
    Given site/src/scripts/charts.js imports helpers from ./util.js
    When the test suite scans charts.js for local declarations
    Then no const, let, var, function or parameter reuses an imported helper's name
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Log: the rename (size -> side) already landed in 589809b and shipped in 1.57.0, so this branch adds only the regression spec site/test/no-shadowed-imports.test.mjs (a962105). Watched it fail against 589809b^ charts.js (flags line 226 `const size = ...`); on the fixed tree `npm run build` (1114 pages) and `npm test` (47/47) pass. PR into develop on fix/spider-size-shadow.
